name: CIMB Group Holdings Berhad
oneLine: A bank for individuals, businesses and large institutions across ASEAN, headquartered in Kuala Lumpur.
inPlainWords: CIMB is a bank. It serves over 30 million customers through 576 branches, with about 33,000 employees.
It calls itself an ASEAN bank: besides Malaysia it operates in Indonesia, Singapore, Thailand, Cambodia, Vietnam and the Philippines, with branches in Shanghai, Hong Kong and the United Kingdom.
Malaysia is the biggest part, but Indonesia (through 292 branches) and Singapore are large contributors too.

flow.label: Depositors
flow.detail: Customers place savings and deposits with the bank, which pays them interest.

flow.label: The bank
flow.detail: It lends that money out at a higher rate. The gap is net interest income, its main income.

flow.label: Borrowers
flow.detail: Home buyers, car buyers, businesses and large corporations pay interest on loans.

flow.label: Fees and markets
flow.detail: It also earns non-interest income: fees, commissions and treasury and markets income.

moneyNote: Wholesale Banking, which serves large companies and institutions, made 28% of revenue but 42% of pre-tax profit in 2025 (calculated from the segment figures).
